meta.note: Values are resolved from the Radix Colors 3.0.0 slate, sand and tomato ramps that app/globals.css imports. Nothing here is approximated.

tokens.name: substrate
tokens.usage: The desk the page sits on: body and .site-shell background, behind every paper surface. Never put text on it directly. slate-3.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background — the sheet reader copy is printed on. App token --background. slate-2 (light) / slate-dark-2.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised card, popover and panel ground on top of paper. App tokens --card/--popover/--surface. slate-1. In dark this is darker than paper, per the Radix panel convention.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fill for secondary buttons, table zebra rows, empty states and hovered rows. App tokens --secondary/--muted/--surface-muted. slate-3.

tokens.name: surface-accent
tokens.usage: Second-step fill: pressed or selected chrome, active tab ground. App token --accent. slate-4.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default body and reader copy on paper or surface. 5.65:1 on paper (light), 8.45:1 (dark). App tokens --foreground/--ink. slate-11.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headlines, mastheads, emphasised numerals and primary button fill. 15.6:1 on paper. App tokens --foreground-strong/--primary. slate-12.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, bylines, timestamps and placeholder text. Measures 3.6:1 on paper (light) and 4.15:1 (dark), so it clears 3:1 but NOT 4.5:1 — use it only for furniture at 14px+ bold or 24px+, never for sentences a reader must read. App tokens --foreground-muted/--muted-foreground. slate-10.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink-strong fill (primary buttons, inverted bands). 16:1 against ink-strong. slate-1.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control and card borders: inputs, outline buttons, panel edges. App tokens --border/--input. slate-6. 1.34:1 against paper — decorative separation only; never the sole signal that a control exists.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Newspaper rules: section rules, column rules, masthead hairlines, deck rules. App token --rule. slate-7.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour as shipped today (app token --ring, slate-8). 1.82:1 on paper, below the 3:1 a focus indicator needs — pair it with ring-strong or use ring-strong instead on paper surfaces.

tokens.name: ring-strong
tokens.usage: Accessible focus ring added by this system (slate-11): 5.65:1 on paper light, 8.45:1 dark. Use for the 3px focus ring on any interactive element that sits on paper or surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive and alarm FILL and iconography: tomato-9, the one hue in the system. App token --destructive/--danger. As text on paper it is only 3.68:1 (light) — fill with it, write with danger-text.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Accessible destructive label and link colour added by this system (tomato-11): 4.74:1 on paper light, 8.36:1 dark. Use wherever destructive copy must be read.

tokens.name: danger-contrast
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid danger fill. App token --destructive-foreground.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control border and text, paired with opacity-disabled. App token --disabled. slate-8.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Alias. The single high-emphasis action colour; Papyrus has no separate brand hue — emphasis is ink weight, not colour.

tokens.name: primary-contrast
tokens.usage: Alias. Label colour on a primary fill.

tokens.name: verdict-match
tokens.usage: Fill for an agreement between a machine prediction and a human answer: the confidence bar when the verdict is Match. Feed register only.

tokens.name: verdict-match-tint
tokens.usage: 20% wash of verdict-match behind a Match cell. Light and dark differ in lightness, not only hue.

tokens.name: verdict-match-ink
tokens.usage: Label and icon inside a Match cell. The dark value is a light mint, so the cell reads on a dark card.

tokens.name: verdict-miss
tokens.usage: Fill for a disagreement: the confidence bar when the verdict is Miss. Feed register only.

tokens.name: verdict-miss-tint
tokens.usage: 20% wash of verdict-miss behind a Miss cell.

tokens.name: verdict-miss-ink
tokens.usage: Label and icon inside a Miss cell.

styles.name: banner
styles.usage: headlineScale "banner" — the one front-page lead. The solver sizes it from block width: clamp(w × 0.105, 54px, 112px) multi-column, clamp(w × 0.13, 42px, 82px) at one column. The value here is the single-column ceiling.

styles.name: feature
styles.usage: headlineScale "feature". Solver: clamp(w × 0.052, 34px, 58px) multi-column; clamp(w × 0.11, 34px, 54px) at one column.

styles.name: standard
styles.usage: headlineScale "standard" — the default inside page headline. Solver: clamp(w × 0.07, 27px, 40px) multi-column.

styles.name: rail
styles.usage: headlineScale "rail" — narrow sidebar column. Solver: clamp(w × 0.15, 24px, 34px) multi-column.

styles.name: brief
styles.usage: headlineScale "brief" — briefs, corrections, promos. Solver: clamp(w × 0.055, 18px, 26px) multi-column.

styles.name: reader-copy
styles.sample: Measured article copy, laid out line by line by Pretext.
styles.usage: Article and blog body copy, four rhythm rows per line. Pretext measures these lines; do not clamp them in CSS.

styles.name: reader-deck
styles.sample: The deck sits under the headline and sets up the story.
styles.usage: Deck / standfirst (.story-deck, .article-deck) in ink-muted at 16px italic, 1.25 leading.

styles.name: reader-caption
styles.usage: Image captions and credits, one rhythm row of leading (--paper-rhythm, 19px).

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Panel and dialog titles in console surfaces (Newsroom, settings, archive chrome).

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: Default console text and button labels; matches the text-sm baseline of the ui primitives.

styles.name: ui-small
styles.sample: Secondary interface copy and help text.
styles.usage: Help text, dense tables, small button labels (size sm).

styles.name: label-section
styles.usage: Section labels and inside-page headers. Always uppercase.

styles.name: label-kicker
styles.usage: Masthead kickers, continuation headings and jump lines. Always uppercase.

styles.name: label-byline
styles.usage: Bylines and datelines (.story-byline) in ink-muted. Always uppercase.

styles.name: label-meta
styles.usage: Meta rows: desk, lane, read time, status. Always uppercase.

spacing.note: Steps taken from the shipped control and page geometry; the 7px reader rhythm lives in the Rhythm family.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets and the 1px press translate on buttons.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in xs and sm controls.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap in default and lg controls; inset for leading icons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight control padding, chip insets, gap between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Default horizontal padding of a button or input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding at small sizes; gap between fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Standard panel padding and grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section spacing inside a panel; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between major page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page-level separation above a section rule.

radius.note: Reader surfaces are square; console chrome is rounded. --radius is 0.875rem (14px) and the steps derive from it.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every reader surface: pages, columns, media insets, rules. Paper does not have rounded corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: xs controls and chips in console chrome.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: sm controls, inputs, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Default button, card and popover radius (--radius).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and large panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and toggles only.

shadow.note: Papyrus separates with rules and borders, not elevation. The only shipped shadow is the drop shadow that lifts a page off the desk.

tokens.name: paper-drop
tokens.usage: Lifts a page or dialog off the substrate. Dark adds a light counter-layer so the sheet stays visible on a near-black desk.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 3px focus ring, drawn in ring-strong at half alpha. Pair with a solid ring-strong border on the control itself.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls, applied to the whole element with pointer events off.

tokens.name: opacity-rule-soft
tokens.usage: Deck and inset rules drawn from rule at reduced strength.

tokens.name: opacity-ink-display
tokens.usage: Display ink on paper, so headlines read as printed rather than painted. Dark mode raises this to 0.96.

control.note: Control heights as shipped by components/ui/button.tsx. Inputs and selects match them.

tokens.name: control-xs
tokens.usage: Dense table and toolbar actions (size xs).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Secondary actions inside panels (size sm).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default control height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary page-level action (size lg).

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Borders, column rules and masthead hairlines.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Section rules and appendix dividers — the heavier newspaper rule.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, matching focus-ring.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Lucide icon stroke width (--newsroom-icon-stroke-width); unitless by design.

rhythm.note: Vertical rhythm is solver-owned. These are the shipped values a surface must align to.

tokens.name: rhythm-base
tokens.usage: The reader baseline unit; reader leading is a multiple of it.

tokens.name: rhythm-line
tokens.usage: Four rhythm rows: one line of reader-copy.

tokens.name: rhythm-progress
tokens.usage: Edition progress band height (--edition-progress-height) and the caption leading that matches it.
